text:
Elena Park: Heads-up - new SI wants a "starter kit" intake so they don't have to push the entire SOC/pen artifacts upfront. can we define a 'starter' artifact list and presign flow they can use to get listed in the marketplace sandbox?
Tomas Alvarez: sounds reasonable. propose starter = 1) SOC2 cover + attestation OR letter of attestation, 2) pen test exec summary + latest remediation status, 3) basic network diagram, 4) responsible contact. minimal expected files, redactions allowed.
Rajesh Iyer: compliance flag: we can accept starter but must label as "limited review" in the listing metadata and require full artifacts on a 30d runway or before GA. also need checkbox for any crypto/HSM usage.
Nina Gomez: for hardware SIs add device attestations: firmware signing cert fingerprint + build date. if they can't provide certs we require a plan and timeline.
Elena Park: ok can someone draft the starter manifest and the presign requirements? need to tell partner by EOD Mon.
Tomas Alvarez: i'll sketch manifest and add a small GH Action to create presigned links in `repos/partnerships/playbooks/onboarding`. presign TTL = 72h, SSE required, and links scoped to `partners/<ts>-<partner>/starter/`.
Rajesh Iyer: security requirements to include in message: no PII in uploads, no plaintext keys, zip archives allowed but must contain a manifest file at top-level. we'll also run a malware scan on uploads.
Elena Park: sample starter_manifest (tiny) below so partner knows what to upload:
```json
{
  "partner_name": "BluePeak Integrations",
  "submitted_on": "2026-04-02",
  "type": "starter",
  "files": [
    "soc2-attestation.pdf",
    "pen-exec-summary.pdf",
    "net-diagram.svg",
    "contact-info.txt"
  ],
  "notes": "firmware-attestation.json if HW"
}
```
ComplianceBot: FYI - tags added: #starter-review #limited-profile. Required follow-up: full-report-request in 30 days if listing moves to prod.
Infra Upload Bot: presign location created: `s3://redwood-incoming/partners/3951234567-bluepeak/starter/`. presign TTL 72h. Server-side encryption (SSE-S3) enforced. Manual upload link: https://upload.internal.redwood/3951234567-bluepeak (auth required).
Rajesh Iyer: action owners: Tomas -> manifest + GH Action (due Fri), Partner -> upload starter bundle (due Mon EOD), Nina -> HW attestation review if present (2bd). i'll own compliance flagging and metadata.
Elena Park: perfect. i'll send the partner the one-pager and ask them to use the presign link. thanks all :rocket:
